question: With architecture, dataset, optimiser, epochs and batch size held fixed, does the learning-rate schedule family alone reproduce the risk split seen in B1, where the discontinuous families were also different architectures?

evaluation.gamma_source: certified on the 142-job development corpus (paper, RQ1)

gate.definition: do not stop at epoch t when a scheduled event t_d satisfies t_d - h <= t <= t_d
gate.h_source: fixed a priori, not tuned on B5

predictions_fixed_before_the_run.P1: with the confound removed, the schedule still separates risk: cosine inside rho, step and one-cycle above it
predictions_fixed_before_the_run.P2: the gate reduces step and one-cycle risk without changing cosine, because cosine declares no event
predictions_fixed_before_the_run.falsification: if all three schedules land within rho, the B1 split was an architecture effect and the paper's central claim fails
